questions.in_scope: Is this R package's purpose the analysis, annotation, visualization or access of biological or biomedical data (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, imaging, etc.)?
questions.uses_bioc_classes: Does the package build on standard Bioconductor data structures (e.g. SummarizedExperiment, SingleCellExperiment, GRanges, Biostrings, MultiAssayExperiment) according to its Imports/Depends?
questions.needs_bioc_classes: Does this package work with data that Bioconductor already has standard containers for (count or expression matrices with sample metadata, genomic ranges, sequences, single-cell data)?
questions.general_tool: Is this a reusable, general-purpose tool rather than code for a single paper, dataset or lab pipeline?
questions.bioc_fit: Would an experienced Bioconductor package reviewer consider this package a good fit for Bioconductor as submitted?
